claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Pyrimethamine at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent; its weak DHFR inhibition is cytostatic rather than cytotoxic and no dominant off-target killing is anticipated at this concentration.
